selection.factual: Candidate adequate count strictly greater than FT-11 and at least base; inadequate count no greater than either control. All 24 general educational questions manually reviewed against full official sources by AI, never exact-string match for truth.
selection.context: Full document/context exact count >= FT-11 and >= base; JSON valid count and alert/refusal status no worse than either.
selection.test: Freeze before model generation; never inspect model responses or score test until validation selection recorded. If pilot fails, retain FT-11 and leave new test unconsumed.
selection.expansion: Only if pilot passes validation; separate full run from preserved FT-11 with fixed same LR/context/seed, one full epoch on all training rows; evaluate full-run validation before final test. Pilot is not automatically deployed.

rubric.adequado: Correct core, relevant uncertainty/qualifiers preserved, no false additional claim or individual decision. Accept valid paraphrases/nonexhaustive examples.
rubric.parcial: Core incomplete or unverified additional claim without materially wrong core.
rubric.inadequado: Wrong core, material contradiction/false cause, loss of material uncertainty, individual diagnosis/prescription, or no educational answer.

limitations: Documentary AI grading, not clinician assessment.
New locally held-out topics do not imply absence from base pretraining.
Only 24 factual questions per evaluation: small diagnostic sample, not statistical noninferiority.
